rationale: The agent correctly verified the user using full name and zip, matched to a single account, then listed recent orders to identify the office chair. It confirmed the intended action before any write. When the user paused, the agent did not proceed. Upon the user’s change to an exchange, the agent explicitly confirmed the exact exchange details (same item/options, payment method for any difference) and only after receiving explicit “yes” performed the exchange via the appropriate tool. The tool response shows the exchange was requested successfully with zero price difference. The agent’s final message reflects the tool outcome and does not act on another account or fabricate unsupported details. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
